svg.aria-label: EventLottery: Android app for fair, lottery based event registration
svg.title: EventLottery: Android app for fair, lottery based event registration
svg.text: Fair registration for community centre events that fill up in seconds.
Entrants join a waiting list, organizers run a lottery draw, and a declined
spot triggers a replacement draw on its own.
My part: login and sign up, the map view with geolocation checks,
comment editing, and the admin profile tab.
